hook: A stress-body RNA concentrates SRSF proteins and recruits only activated CLK1 to speed their phosphorylation
hook_turn: and recruits only activated CLK1 to speed their phosphorylation
summary: In stressed human cells, the HSATIII RNA scaffold of nuclear stress bodies gathers SRSF proteins, which recruit the ASAP complex, which in turn captures activated CLK1 kinase. This speeds SRSF phosphorylation during recovery. The evidence is cell work plus test-tube reconstitution, so the role in whole organisms is untested.
title: An architectural RNA builds a reaction crucible through molecular concentration and activated enzyme selection
